claims.kill: Foldseek's Fmax on Pfam domains is more than 0.05 below phmmer's, a sequence-only search, on any relative Foldseek searched
claims.scope: Pfam-A domain instances, raw calls, 998 human queries, the 10 relatives with Foldseek rows (setting 3di_aa against AlphaFold structures). Tests the "sensitive" half only; speed is on the Cost page and is not part of this test. Pfam domains are defined from sequence, which favours sequence searches like phmmer; a structure-based truth set would be the fairer test and is not on this site yet.

author_claim.quote: Foldseek enables fast and sensitive comparisons of large protein structure sets
